scope: All 92 stable RU/Latin names, codes, bone owners and sides preserved and checked by Node. Existing regional TA98 scope reused; no claim to newly read 92 FIPAT pages or acquire the Russian 2003 atlas.

hierarchy.petrous: Temporal part; apex is a bony region, not a point. Existing grouping of petromastoid terms retained; modern texts may separately describe mastoid part.
hierarchy.tympanic: Bony plate and ring, distinct from fibrous annulus. Junctions of components are not inter-bone relations.
hierarchy.jugular_notch: Codes .06.039 and .06.045 remain compatible catalogue views; note repaired to list both. Existing IDs/positions not merged without geometry evidence.
